item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 01/Jan/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will bring generally fine weather to the coast of southern China tomorrow. The weather will remain cool in the morning over the region. The monsoon is expected to be gradually replaced by an easterly airstream early next week. Another surge of the northeast monsoon will bring slightly cooler weather to Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week. There will also be a few rain patches over the region.

R.H. range: 55 - 80 per Cent
